ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated on the distal lobes and 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the central and axial regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the outer lateral 1/3 of each lobe. The central 1/3 is a solid dark mass. Transition zones between dark and light regions exhibit high-frequency pixel mottling (speckling) with isolated white 'islands' within the dark central area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge. A distinct macro-scale notch or tissue loss is visible on the inner-distal portion of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the lateral tips inward, transitioning to a slight concavity immediately adjacent to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of dark focal points are visible on the distal white regions of both lobes, particularly high-density on the far-left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, parallel, dark-toned diagonal linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the left lobe. Fainter, unaligned linear scratches are present on the white surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation (possible predator mark or trauma) on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Extensive rake mark scarring on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique salt-and-pepper mottling pattern at the transition boundary between the white distal zones and black central zone.
